entries.title: Psalms 139:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician. A Psalm of David.>> Jehovah, thou hast searched me, and known [me].

entries.title: Psalms 139:2
segments: *Thou* knowest my down-sitting and mine uprising, thou understandest my thought afar off;

entries.title: Psalms 139:3
segments: Thou searchest out my path and my lying down, and art acquainted with all my ways;

entries.title: Psalms 139:4
segments: For there is not yet a word on my tongue, [but] lo, O Jehovah, thou knowest it altogether.

entries.title: Psalms 139:5
segments: Thou hast beset me behind and before, and laid thy hand upon me.

entries.title: Psalms 139:6
segments: O knowledge too wonderful for me! it is high, I cannot [attain] unto it.

entries.title: Psalms 139:7
segments: ¶Whither shall I go from thy Spirit? and whither flee from thy presence?

entries.title: Psalms 139:8
segments: If I ascend up into the heavens thou art there; or if I make my bed in Sheol, behold, thou [art there];

entries.title: Psalms 139:9
segments: [If] I take the wings of the dawn [and] dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea,

entries.title: Psalms 139:10
segments: Even there shall thy hand lead me, and thy right hand shall hold me.

entries.title: Psalms 139:11
segments: And if I say, Surely darkness shall cover me, and the light about me be night;

entries.title: Psalms 139:12
segments: Even darkness hideth not from thee, and the night shineth as the day: the darkness is as the light.

entries.title: Psalms 139:13
segments: For thou hast possessed my reins; thou didst cover me in my mother's womb.

entries.title: Psalms 139:14
segments: I will praise thee, for I am fearfully, wonderfully made. Marvellous are thy works; and [that] my soul knoweth right well.

entries.title: Psalms 139:15
segments: My bones were not hidden from thee when I was made in secret, curiously wrought in the lower parts of the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 139:16
segments: Thine eyes did see my unformed substance, and in thy book all [my members] were written; [during many] days were they fashioned, when [as yet] there was none of them.

entries.title: Psalms 139:17
segments: ¶But how precious are thy thoughts unto me, O *God! how great is the sum of them!

entries.title: Psalms 139:18
segments: [If] I would count them, they are more in number than the sand. When I awake, I am still with thee.

entries.title: Psalms 139:19
segments: Oh that thou wouldest slay the wicked, O +God! And ye men of blood, depart from me.

entries.title: Psalms 139:20
segments: For they speak of thee wickedly, they take [thy name] in vain, thine enemies.

entries.title: Psalms 139:21
segments: Do not I hate them, O Jehovah, that hate thee? and do not I loathe them that rise up against thee?

entries.title: Psalms 139:22
segments: I hate them with perfect hatred; I account them mine enemies.

entries.title: Psalms 139:23
segments: Search me, O *God, and know my heart; prove me, and know my thoughts;

entries.title: Psalms 139:24
segments: And see if there be any grievous way in me; and lead me in the way everlasting.
